_meta.what: The legal limit next to the real speed on every road piece.
_meta.real: TomTom measured free-flow speed (third-party, measured; clear roads, not rush hour). Pieces TomTom has no flow for were timed with TomTom routing end to end (route): those times include turns and stops, so they are kept apart (route_over_limit_median) and left out of real_over_limit_median and the street table
_meta.pieces: edge id -> [TomTom km/h, posted km/h, flow or route]
_meta.limit: City of Niagara Falls posted speed limits (government data); QEW/405 at the provincial 100 km/h
_meta.speed_where_unmeasured: limit x real_over_limit_median of the road type
